tasks.title: E21 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E21 (Integration, evidence and demonstration). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E21.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E21/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E21/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10). Restart note: the 20:37 path violation was the coordinator's own files, not yours. You own all of eval/runner/, package initializers included. The engine conftest error comes from passing scenario test files that do not exist yet: pytest then loads tests/conftest.py from the repository root; it goes away once your files exist. R-E21-1/2/3, the crew UI and providers not built yet: rule 0, build against fakes and keep going. Live model and hardware rig runs are not gates of this task: list them in the report as not run.

Execution-scope rule, binding for every gate: distinguish a successful scoped execution from epic acceptance. A scoped invocation fails any failed/error/unrun clause assigned to that invocation; clauses outside its explicit source-derived model/hardware preconditions remain not_selected with their reason and in the full denominator. No skip/xfail, silently changed precondition or missing assigned clause earns success. T1 freezes these obligations in registry.json from E21 sections 3/12/15 and VALIDATION, and checks the expected nonempty collection before dispatch. Stub CI runs every applicable software clause through the real hub with E17 scripted external model and documented acquisition fakes only where the source permits SIM. It cannot earn D09's LIVE capture or real hardware clauses. Stopped CI is the explicit fallback subset: SC-01/SC-10, W1.6 and the stopped/fixed-flow portions of V01/V69/V97 and D05/D15/D23/D41; all other obligations stay not_selected for this run. Live table_min runs the real-model and real-hardware obligations plus the complete applicable live demo/skeleton path; stub-only malicious-script variants remain required evidence from a separate stub run. Stub table_min runs the full applicable frozen demo with actual LIVE presenter acquisition where required, despite the model being stubbed. A task's complete acceptance and final report --check require the union of every required compatible stub/stopped/live/hardware clause, never the best outcome per clause or suppression of a failure. All executed failures in the candidate evidence set remain promotion blockers until fixed and retested under a new identified build/run. In addition, freeze/recording requires a complete clean live six-act run on one frozen build, not a composite of successful fragments; full stub six-act evidence is also required. Missing hardware leaves full acceptance open even if the software CI scope passes. Mode/origin/rig evidence must reflect actual execution. No task treats scoped CI success as done when its required external evidence is still absent.

Pure runner unit-test collection must not recursively schedule the scenario registry or require unbuilt providers merely to test missing-provider verdicts. Only explicit scenario invocations collect executable V/D aliases, and those enforce their mode obligations. A unit test that demonstrates correct not_run accounting does not claim acceptance for the missing scenario.
